name: Williamson Family Farm
description: Williamson Family Farm is a small farm in Murfreesboro, TN. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Blackberries, Apples, and Pumpkins, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
